papers.title: IntBMoE: Integrating Block-Level Conditioning into Expert Composition for Full-Participation Mixture-of-Experts
papers.desc: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) scales capacity, but existing designs cannot set three quantities independently.

papers.title: OmniVChat: Synthesizing, Benchmarking, and Training for Native Audio-Visual Dialogue
papers.desc: We define OmniVChat (Omni Video Chat) as the task of native audio-visual dialogue between a user and an omni model.

papers.title: Designer-RSI: Evolving Procedural Memory from User Traffic for Agentic Graphic Design
papers.desc: Professional graphic design is a long-horizon agentic task in which structured, editable artifacts emerge from many interdependent actions, yet outcomes admit no reliable programmatic oracle.

papers.title: BI-Agent and BI-Bench: Towards Automating End-to-End Business Intelligence
papers.desc: Business intelligence (BI) is a cornerstone of enterprise decision-making and is widely used by enterprise users in software such as Power BI and Tableau.

papers.title: Gricea: An Open Science Platform for Conversational AI Research
papers.desc: We need studies on conversational AI (CAI) at scale to understand human behavior and shape CAI design.

papers.title: CADWorld: Computer-Use Benchmark for Long-Horizon Computer-Aided Design
papers.desc: Computer-use agents are increasingly evaluated in realistic desktop environments, but existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of professional engineering workflows whose outputs are persistent, structured artifacts.

papers.title: GAVEL: Graph World Models for Verified and Efficient Long-Horizon LLM Task Planning
papers.desc: Large language models (LLMs) provide a flexible interface for long-horizon robot planning, but generated plans often fail to respect embodiment constraints, recover from planning errors, or reason effectively under partial observability.

papers.title: Geometry of Values: Task Vector Composition for Ethical Preference Alignment in Language Models
papers.desc: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in applications that must weigh clashing moral values, yet even strong models exhibit hidden biases and brittle instruction-following across languages.

papers.title: FRAUDSkill: Structured Frozen-Weight Skill Optimization for Audio Anti-Fraud Detection
papers.desc: Large audio-language models have shown promise for anti-fraud detection by directly processing speech and reasoning over fraud-related evidence.

papers.title: TeleAntiFraud 2.0: A Refreshable, Profile-Grounded, and Audio-Based Benchmark for Telecom Fraud Detection
papers.desc: Telecom fraud scripts evolve rapidly and are often designed to resemble routine service conversations, creating two key requirements for audio-based telecom-fraud evaluation.

papers.title: From Pretraining to Proficiency: Real-World Subtask RL for Long-Horizon Manipulation with Minimal Human Intervention
papers.desc: A pretrained robot foundation policy may execute most of a long-horizon task yet repeatedly fail at a few critical subtasks.

papers.title: SiliconBench: Speed, Memory, and Fidelity for LLM Serving on Unified-Memory Desktops
papers.desc: Concurrent local LLM serving on unified-memory desktops must preserve memory headroom and output fidelity, which speed-only rankings overlook.

papers.title: APort Vault: Benchmarking AI Agent Payment Authorization with the Open Agent Passport
papers.desc: APort Vault is a benchmark for payment authorization in tool-using AI agents.

papers.title: Refinement Is Inherently Editable: Training-Free Prompt-to-Prompt Image Editing with Generative Refinement Network
papers.desc: Text-guided image editing must introduce the requested changes while preserving unrelated source content.

papers.title: Retention-Constrained Post-Training Quantization of Cellpose-SAM for Stem Cell Microscopy
papers.desc: Induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) culture increasingly relies on segmentation foundation models, yet deployment on laboratory CPUs and edge hardware requires compression schemes that are both efficient and auditable.
